description:
Embedded Software Engineer 

 Do you enjoy developing embedded software and control systems for critical energy, power generation, and industrial applications?
 Are you passionate about solving complex engineering challenges across embedded software, electronics, and industrial automation technologies?

 Partner with the best 

 Baker Hughes is a global leader in energy technology, transforming the energy landscape through our cutting-edge solutions and market-leading business segments. With over a century of expertise and operations in more than 120 countries, we are driving the future of energy—making it safer, cleaner, and more efficient for people and the planet.

 Our Industry & Energy Technology (IET) team provides industry-leading products and services that optimize the extraction, production, and processing of energy. We help a diverse range of customers across the value chain to reduce operating costs and improve productivity. Our team plays an integral role by helping the business plan for the future.

 Fuel Your Passion 

 As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will play a key role in developing Baker Hughes' next-generation PRISMIC control systems used across power generation, industrial automation, and critical energy applications worldwide. You will work at the intersection of embedded software, electronics, and control systems engineering, designing and delivering high-performance solutions that enable the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of complex industrial equipment.

 Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, you will develop Embedded C/C++ software within Linux, QNX, and Real-Time Operating System (RTOS) environments, integrating software and hardware to create robust control solutions. From system architecture and product development through testing, validation, and deployment, you will contribute across the full product lifecycle while helping shape the future direction of our control systems portfolio.

 This is an exciting opportunity for an engineer with a passion for embedded technology, industrial control systems, and real-world engineering challenges, who is eager to develop innovative solutions that support the future of energy. We're particularly interested in engineers who combine strong embedded software expertise with a genuine passion for Industrial Control Systems, electronics, and solving real-world engineering challenges. 

 As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will be responsible for: 
 Designing and developing embedded software using C/C++ for microcontrollers, QNX, and Embedded Linux environments.
 Supporting the design and development of electronic hardware including PCBs, controllers, and I/O modules.
 Integrating embedded software with hardware systems ensuring seamless system performance.
 Implementing industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, CAN, Ethernet, and IEC standards.
 Performing system testing, validation, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.
 Developing test procedures and ensuring compliance with system requirements and quality standards.
 Supporting full product lifecycle activities including design, documentation, and field support.
 Collaborating with cross-functional teams across engineering, manufacturing, Suppliers and service.
 
 To be successful in this role you will: 
 Have significant experience developing embedded control systems for industrial automation, power generation, turbine controls, compressor controls, or related energy applications.
 Have advanced C/C++ development experience within real-time embedded environments.
 Have hands-on experience with industrial control systems, PLCs, DCS, SCADA platforms, or equivalent control architectures.
 Have experience designing and implementing control algorithms and closed-loop control strategies.
 Have a degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Systems Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline.
 Have experience with QNX, RTOS, or Embedded Linux within industrial control applications.
 Have working knowledge of IEC61508, SIL-rated products, functional safety principles, or safety-critical systems.
 Have experience supporting commissioning, validation, troubleshooting, or deployment of industrial control equipment in manufacturing, field, or customer environments.
 Have experience with industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, CAN, EtherNet/IP, Profinet, or IEC61850.
 Have experience using Git/GitHub and modern software configuration management practices.
 
 Work in a way that works for you 

 We recognize that everyone is different and that the way people work and perform at their best varies from person to person. In this role, we offer a hybrid working model, providing the flexibility to work from home up to two days per week while meeting the needs of the business. You will be expected to work from our Ashby de la Zouch office in Leicestershire a minimum of three days per week , collaborating closely with colleagues and supporting hands-on engineering and product development activities.

 Working with us 

 Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

 Working for you 

 Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:
 Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
 Comprehensive private medical care options
 Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
 Tailored financial programs
 Additional elected or voluntary benefits
  
 Join Us 

 Join Baker Hughes and help develop next-generation PRISMIC control systems that power critical energy, power generation, and industrial automation applications worldwide. We're looking for engineers who combine strong embedded software expertise with a genuine passion for control systems, electronics, and solving real-world engineering challenges.
 
 
The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Engineer 1, Automation & Control, Product Design and Engineering
